utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I heard you're organizing a repair drive? Need any help rounding up supplies?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That'd be great, Ira. I've got a list of what we need—let's stick to that and we'll be done in no time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, just show me the list and I'll grab what I can from my garage.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a bit of a rush.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's a community thing. Bring broken items to the garage this Saturday. 10-4.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday 10-4. I'll see if I can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is actually going to work?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope so, but I'm a bit worried it might not have enough power for all the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You think it might not have enough power? What else could go wrong?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I almost forgot. What's the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're collecting scrap and tools from everyone to fix the shared generator. Got any spare parts?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Let me check my garage—I think I've got some old wires and a wrench somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, you mean the repair drive for the community center? Can you tell me more about what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I think the old piping in the kitchen is leaking, but I might be mixing it up with something else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check with the maintenance logs; I want to be sure it's the kitchen piping before we start anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, what's the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, no worries! I just checked on it—looks like the drive is almost ready, just needs a final test.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That's great to hear! Anything I can help with for the final test?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: The repair drive? I'm happy to lend a hand—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, I've got a solid toolkit if anyone's short on supplies. Just holler if you need a wrench or a drill.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus! I might just need a drill for the loose boards on my fence.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Faye, I heard you're heading to the repair drive later. Do you know the address?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's at 123 Main Street, the community center. I'll be there after dropping the kids at school.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll note that down. I might stop by myself if I get the chance.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, did you hear about the repair drive the community center is organizing this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, I heard! I'm already planning to tell everyone on my block. Want me to spread the word for you too?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that would be wonderful, thanks Quinn! I'll bring some old tools from my garage.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's this repair drive you mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a community project to fix up old tools and appliances. We're gathering items this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time and where should I bring my broken blender?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hi Nell! Are you going to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't heard much about that. What's it about exactly?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's a community event where we fix broken items together—electronics, clothes, furniture. Everyone brings something to repair or helps others. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli! I was hoping to catch you—are you still interested in helping with the neighborhood repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, hi Rosa. I'm not sure if I'll be able to... things are a bit complicated right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries at all, Uli. If you want to talk about what's going on, I'm here to listen. But no pressure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, did you hear about the repair drive they're organizing down the street? I heard they're fixing up old appliances for folks in need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, a repair drive? Sounds interesting. Do they have a set schedule or is it just whenever?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think they're setting up this Saturday from 9 to 3 at the community center. Heard they're looking for volunteers too!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Vik. What did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Dane! We're planning to meet at the community center this Saturday at 10 AM to fix up old appliances. Bring your tools!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Saturday at 10. I'll bring my toolbox. Thanks for filling me in!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, a repair drive? That sounds helpful.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I hope they can fix my old washing machine—it's been giving me trouble.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I hope they can help you too. What's wrong with it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that...

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's at the old warehouse on Maple Street, right? I saw a sign about it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Maple Street warehouse? Sounds about right, though I didn't catch the sign myself.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? I heard it could use a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What kind of repairs are we doing? I want to make sure I have the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We'll be fixing up the community garden shed and a few benches — basic carpentry and some painting. Shouldn't need anything too fancy, but bring a hammer if you've got one!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I've been a bit out of it lately. What's going on with it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a neighborhood event where we all pitch in to fix up homes and common areas. We could really use your help—do you have any skills to share?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, skills? I mean, I can probably hold a hammer without hurting myself too much. What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Gus, how's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's going great, Ira! Got a few folks lined up to help fix things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's wonderful! Let me know if you need any extra hands—I'm free this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, what's the repair drive all about? Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm fixing up old bikes for kids in the neighborhood. Could use some help with the gears.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'm pretty handy with gears. Let me grab my tools and I'll be right over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we figured out how we're going to coordinate all the repairs? I'm worried about timing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have a list of who needs what done and their availability?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No, not yet. I'm worried about getting everyone's schedules to align.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm helping spread the word—would you be interested?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, yes! I've been organizing our tool inventory—happy to help out with whatever supplies are needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Cleo! Let's sync up after I finish the flyers so we can match tools to tasks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, the repair drive? That sounds great. When are you planning to hold it? I can help coordinate with other parents to make sure we have volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You know, I think it's next Saturday? I really should write these things down more often.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let me double-check the school calendar — I'll text you the exact time and date.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell! I'm so glad we're finally getting together to plan the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I've heard a bit about it from others. What's the plan exactly?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, we're aiming to collect small appliances and electronics from neighbors, then we'll have a weekend where volunteers help fix them up for reuse or recycling.
